Use case: identity-preserve / game character hair layer. Create ONE NEW HAND-DRAWN HAIR COMPONENT on a genuinely TRANSPARENT 1024 x 1536 RGBA canvas. Image 1 is the user's sole hairstyle and hair-rendering reference (three front-view hairstyles LEFT, MIDDLE, RIGHT). Image 2 is the fixed blank face/ears/neck layer that this hair MUST fit, at its exact current size and placement on the 1024x1536 canvas. DO NOT render image 2 itself. Preserve that face's physical proportions in the hair opening; do not redraw or include skin. The three-column reference is a cropped head-and-shoulders close-up, NOT a full-canvas scale template: keep the hair proportional to the fixed face in image 2. Strictly FRONT VIEW, no tilt, no profile, no back-of-person view. Same fine gongbi ink illustration as image1, delicate individually delineated strands, muted matte warm charcoal near-black hair, restrained warm grey highlights, natural directional strands. No glossy white streaks, no 3D plastic, no grey/white/blonde hair, no new jewelry, no typography, no shadows outside hair. Canvas top-left origin shared across components: fixed head center x519, bare scalp approx x401..637 y209..400, visible face chin at (519,543), hairline center approx (518,257), hairline sides (442,310)/(596,310). Hair should stay within x200..825, hair top around y100..165. The rest of this tall canvas should be transparent, do not enlarge the hair to fill it. Match reference silhouette and tiny loose wisps. No facial features, face, ears, neck, skin, mannequin, clothing, shoulders, background, labels, frame, guides, checkerboard or extra components. Output just this one hair layer, not a sheet.
STYLE: LEFT hairstyle: elegant center-parted half-up long hair, swept layered side sections, small raised rear bun held by a horizontal simple dark hair stick, long loose flowing rear hair; two narrow natural face-framing front strands extending to chest.
COMPONENT: FRONT HAIR LAYER ONLY: include the front scalp cap from center part through forehead hairline, swept temple hair (and visible outer temple braids for style03), fine cheek-framing wisps and the TWO slender chest-front hanging locks as in image1. The face opening must be transparent. Omit rear bun, hair stick, rear crown volume, all hair behind ears/neck/shoulders, and broad loose back-hair curtains. No skin or ear-shaped cutout/notches: end temples naturally into strands. Top/front cap is an arch around the transparent face opening, NOT a complete solid back silhouette. Match fixed face2.
